questions.text:
Consider a complete binary tree with 7 nodes. Let A denote the set of first 3 elements obtained by performing Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the root. Let B denote the set of first 3 elements obtained by performing Depth-First Search (DFS) starting from the root.

The value of |A-B| is _____________
questions.solution:
Complete binary tree with 7 nodes: root, its two children L and R, and four grandchildren.
- BFS first 3: root, L, R [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] A = {root, L, R}
- DFS first 3: root, L, L's left child [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] B = {root, L, LL}

A [latex]-[/latex] B = {R} [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] |A [latex]-[/latex] B| = 1

Answer: 1

questions.text:
Consider the following deterministic finite automaton (DFA)

The number of strings of length 8 accepted by the above automaton is _________
questions.solution:
Every path from the start reaches the final state after exactly 3 symbols (start [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] level 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] level 2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] final, on either symbol at every step), and the final state loops on 0 and 1.

So every string of length [latex]\ge3[/latex] is accepted. Strings of length 8: [latex]2^8=256[/latex].

Answer: 256

questions.text: If [latex]x[/latex] and [latex]y[/latex] are two decimal digits and [latex](0.1101)_2 = (0.8xy5)_{10}[/latex], the decimal value of [latex]x+y[/latex] is ___________
questions.solution:
[latex](0.1101)_2=\frac12+\frac14+\frac1{16}=0.8125[/latex]

0.8xy5 = 0.8125 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] x = 1, y = 2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] x + y = 3

Answer: 3

questions.text: Consider a set-associative cache of size 2KB ([latex]1KB=2^{10}[/latex] bytes) with cache block size of 64 bytes. Assume that the cache is byte-addressable and a 32 -bit address is used for accessing the cache. If the width of the tag field is 22 bits, the associativity of the cache is ______
questions.solution:
Offset = [latex]\log_2 64=6[/latex] bits. Tag = 22 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] set index = 32 [latex]-[/latex] 22 [latex]-[/latex] 6 = 4 bits [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 16 sets.

Lines = 2 KB / 64 B = 32. Associativity = 32 / 16 = 2.

Answer: 2

questions.text: Consider a computer system with DMA support. The DMA module is transferring one 8-bit character in one CPU cycle from a device to memory through cycle stealing at regular intervals. Consider a 2 MHz processor. If 0.5% processor cycles are used for DMA, the data transfer rate of the device is __________ bits per second.
questions.solution:
Cycles used for DMA per second = 0.5% of [latex]2\times10^6[/latex] = [latex]10^4[/latex].
Each cycle moves 8 bits [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]10^4\times8=80000[/latex] bits/s.

Answer: 80000
